task: Make /compact and automatic compaction work for Bedrock-backed Claude models via the SSO provider, fixing litellm.UnsupportedParamsError about a missing 'tools=' param, with the rejecting layer (CLI proxy vs backend LiteLLM) not yet established.

key_reasoning.reason: The failing layer is not established. Checked-in backend litellm_config.yaml already sets modify_params: true (EPMCDME-12762/13136 fix for this exact error). The proxy has no code that drops tools and no captured /compact request exists. Choice between CLI proxy normalizer, LiteLLM/backend config, or no code change is an open design decision.

Closest pattern is claude-request-normalizer / background-request-normalizer, which does not cover this. Proxy cannot tell Bedrock from Vertex for shared aliases; no recorded /compact request shape; injecting tools is new behaviour on a shared request path.
